cues.title: Fort Harrow
cues.subtitle: Campaign 1: The Lantern Road  -  Level 1  -  8 Emberfall 1047 AK
cues.text: Lanterns are going dark on the Lantern Road, and somebody is paying goblins for their cores. Four strangers from Brindle Cross have fought goblins three times in four days, and two days ago they saved the hamlet of Wending Mill from a burning raid. Now they have walked to the far end of the road, to Fort Harrow, to tell Captain Rook what they found. The fort has forty soldiers and no hope of more.
Fort Harrow  -  The Gate  -  Day
Fort Harrow, the far end of the Lantern Road. Grey walls, and one lantern burning by the gate.
Two soldiers lean on the arch. They look as if they haven't slept in a week.
Brannoc, you've asked me how I feel nine times since Wending Mill.
cues.speaker: oriel

cues.text: Ten.
cues.speaker: brannoc

cues.text: I'm well. Truly. Father Tobin says I'm too stubborn to die.
cues.speaker: oriel

cues.text: Sunshine, you scared ten years off the Big Man, and he hasn't got that many left.
cues.speaker: tamsin

cues.text: Two hundred. Give or take.
cues.speaker: brannoc

cues.text: Dwarves commonly live to three hundred and fifty. He is a youth. Technically.
cues.speaker: ilsevel

cues.text: Eight blind, is that Bran Vow? We had you dead in a ditch, Bran!
cues.speaker: dunn

cues.text: Dunn. Still a corporal.
cues.speaker: brannoc

cues.text: Still alive, which is more than the last three sergeants managed. Who're your friends?
cues.speaker: dunn

cues.text: Bran Vow? Sergeant says that's not his name at all. Says he's an Ironvow. An exile, out of Aldhammer.
cues.speaker: ferrick

cues.text: Ferrick. Shut your mouth before I shut it for you.
cues.speaker: dunn

cues.text: Brannoc says nothing at all. His thumb finds the grey paint on his shield. Everyone heard.
So! Corporal. Is there anywhere in this fort a weary traveller can get a hot drink? Asking for the Big Man. He's shy.
cues.speaker: tamsin

cues.text: Mess is by the well. Captain'll want you first, mind.
cues.speaker: dunn

cues.text: Fort Harrow  -  Report. Short Version.  -  Day
Bran.
cues.speaker: edda_rook

cues.text: Captain.
cues.speaker: brannoc

cues.text: Report. Short version.
cues.speaker: edda_rook

cues.text: Lantern Thirty-Seven's core taken by hand. Goblins carting cores east. Paid in food.
cues.speaker: brannoc

cues.text: Wending Mill raided. Saved. Forty-One's dark.
cues.speaker: brannoc

cues.text: That's more words than I've had out of you in three years.
cues.speaker: edda_rook

cues.text: Oriel watches the captain while she listens.

roll.purpose: c1: Read a veteran officer who has spent twenty years not letting her face say anything.

cues.text: Oriel sees the grey under Rook's eyes, and the glances she keeps giving her half-empty walls.
And the way she looks at Brannoc: like someone keeping a door shut for him.
Forty soldiers. A hundred and forty lanterns. I have written to the Crown four times. The Crown writes back.
cues.speaker: edda_rook

cues.text: Ten crowns a week, each of you. Ride the road. Find out who's buying those cores. Short version: I need you.
cues.speaker: edda_rook

cues.text: Ten? Captain, for a company of our quality I'd think twenty. Fifteen. Twelve, and you throw in a spoon.
cues.speaker: tamsin

roll.purpose: c2: Haggle a frontier captain up from ten crowns a week, when her fort is short of soldiers, food and coin, and she know

cues.text: Ten. Take it or walk.
cues.speaker: edda_rook

cues.text: Ten is a lovely number. I've always said so.
cues.speaker: tamsin

cues.text: We accept. Technically the Order already employs me to inspect these lanterns, but I see no conflict.
cues.speaker: ilsevel

cues.text: We accept. All of us.
cues.speaker: oriel

cues.text: And my dispatches for Lamplighters' Hall, soldier? You're three days late.
cues.speaker: edda_rook

cues.text: Still in my pack. Got held up.
cues.speaker: brannoc

cues.text: I am of the Hall. Technically, I can receive them.
cues.speaker: ilsevel

cues.text: Brannoc hands Ilsevel a sealed packet, slightly singed at one corner.
Then they're delivered. Good. Get some food in you.
cues.speaker: edda_rook

cues.text: Fort Harrow  -  Black Glass  -  Evening
Evening. Sergeant Holt's patrol comes in through the gate with a cart, and something long under a sack.
Caught this one at dusk, trying to pry open Lantern Fifty-Two. Didn't get it open. Didn't get away either.
cues.speaker: holt

cues.text: Around the dead goblin's neck, on a greasy cord, hangs a pendant of polished black glass.
You're the Lamplighter. What is it?
cues.speaker: edda_rook

roll.purpose: c3: Make sense of an unknown piece of black glass by lamplight: weight, cold, how the light behaves around it.

cues.text: Ilsevel lifts it toward the lantern. The flame leans toward the glass, the way a candle leans toward an open door, and grows dim.
It is drinking the light. And it is cold. Cold the way the dead cores were cold.
cues.speaker: ilsevel

cues.text: Goblins didn't make that.
cues.speaker: oriel

cues.text: No. Somebody gave it to one.
cues.speaker: brannoc

cues.text: Somebody who pays in sacks of meal, and hands out glass crowns. And now glass necklaces.
cues.speaker: tamsin

cues.text: Holt. Double the watch on the lanterns tonight.
cues.speaker: edda_rook

cues.text: With what, Captain?
cues.speaker: holt

cues.text: ...With what we have.
cues.speaker: edda_rook

cues.text: Then find me that somebody.
cues.speaker: edda_rook

cues.text: I have never read of anything like it. Not in any book. Not once.
cues.speaker: ilsevel

cues.text: Next time: Black glass, and a letter to Lamplighters' Hall.
